summary: This research study is looking at how gut hormones are affected by Roux-en-Y gastric bypass surgery, which is a weight-loss procedure. The study also tests gut hormone infusions, placebo infusions, and very low-calorie diets in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes. Imperial College London is sponsoring this study, which currently has a status of Recruiting. A total of 190 participants are planned to take part.
